title: Fat Shamed By My Doctor | Ella Horwedel | Stand Up Comedy
description:
Ella Horwedel on getting lip filler, what to do when you miss your ex, and the crazy things her middle school students have said to her

Comedy is at its best when there's a surprise – that's why Don't Tell Comedy puts on events where the performers and location are kept secret until the day of the show. With over 200 cities already in on the joke, you never know where we'll set up shop, or who might pop in. Want to be let in on the secret? Visit our website below to find an upcoming show near you: https://www.donttellcomedy.com

Just don't tell anyone!! 🤫

-----------------------------------------------------------

Often described as raunchy, irreverent, and a disappointment by her mother, Ella Horwedel has been an energetic force in the Midwest comedy scene for the past eight years. She has featured and headlined at clubs all over the country, where she explores the difficulties of being a 27-year-old woman through bawdy stories and intimate self-reflection. She has opened for Kyle Kinane, Joe Dombrowski, Ron Funches, Beth Stelling, and Whitney Cummings, and has been featured at some of the best comedy festivals in the country, including Laughing Skull Comedy Festival, Limestone Comedy Festival, 10,000 Laughs Comedy Festival, and Skankfest. She's had numerous viral appearances on the hit show, "My Straight Friends," and earlier this year, she recorded a set with Netflix is a Joke's "Are You Still Listening?"
